verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's core positioning is exactly this workflow: it joins a live gdb session to inspect state (byteask-docs-2), hands back raw reports with frames/files/line numbers so reasoning can be checked against evidence (byteask-docs-3), builds/runs under AddressSanitizer (byteask-docs-17), and drives compiler, sanitizers, test suite, and gdb before producing a diff that 'survived the debugger' (byteask-docs-18, byteask-docs-1). This directly covers reproduction (gdb attach), root-cause narrowing (sanitizer + frame evidence), and fix verification (test suite + diff review). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reports confirming this workflow in practice beyond vendor docs.
